proposal_rules.title: Singular Lookup Cardinality Gate Before OUTCOME_OK
proposal_rules.hypothesis: If rules require exact-match cardinality validation for singular lookup questions before finalization, agents will stop returning false `OUTCOME_OK` when zero (or multiple) matches exist.
proposal_rules.change: Add a compact completion rule: for prompts that presuppose a single exact item (for example, "which one"), verify exact-match cardinality first. If exact matches are not exactly one, do not use `OUTCOME_OK`; return `OUTCOME_NONE_CLARIFICATION` with a minimal disambiguation/confirmation request. Allow `OUTCOME_OK` with a negative result only when the user explicitly asks an existence question (e.g., whether any item exists).
